_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. Airbnb styles itself with the --palette-* variables (ramps plus a semantic bg/text/border/icon layer) resolved on :root, and the --typography-*, --spacing-*, --corner-radius-*, --motion-*, --elevation-* and --material-* scales beside them. A leaf with "var" takes its value from that variable's declaration in raw/css-vars.json; a leaf with "value" carries a value measured on the running page and names the measurement in "source". core.palette holds the ramps; light.color holds the semantic names. The stylesheets also declare every palette name under prefers-color-scheme: dark (and on the always-dark .c12bynq4 class): those become the dark set, though the site itself pins data-color-scheme="light" and never applies them.

focus-ring.$description: The keyboard-focus ring drawn on every header control.

heart-idle.source: measured card-heart default icon fill, raw/components-computed.json
heart-idle.description: The wishlist heart glyph's resting fill over a photo.

heart-stroke.source: measured card-heart default icon stroke, raw/components-computed.json
heart-stroke.description: The white stroke that keeps the heart readable over photos.
